│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│                                                                      │
│ MOD.04 · ARCH — CONTAINER ARCHITECTURE                               │
│                                                                      │
│ One retrofitted shipping container in a dense mixed-wood forest: a   │
│ light steam/solar-punk one-bedroom stonework cabin-shop, off grid.   │
│ Swap the interior modules, change the exterior, then join and stack  │
│ units into something much bigger.                                    │
│                                                                      │
│ interactive 3D configurator: https://gamernation.ca/architecture     │
│                                                                      │
│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ LAYOUTS                                                              │
│                                                                      │
│ SINGLE 20'                                                           │
│   One 20-foot high-cube. Four bays, a door end, a deck. The base     │
│   one-bedroom cabin or a single work unit.                           │
│ SINGLE 40'                                                           │
│   One 40-foot high-cube. Eight bays — room for a bedroom, galley,    │
│   wet room, and a full workshop in one line.                         │
│ TWIN 20'                                                             │
│   Two 20-foot units side by side with the shared wall opened up: a   │
│   4.9 m wide room, eight bays.                                       │
│ STACKED LOFT                                                         │
│   Two 40-foot units on the ground, a third on top with a roof deck   │
│   beside it. Sixteen bays down, eight up.                            │
│ ROMAN COURT                                                          │
│   Two 40-foot and two 20-foot units around a central courtyard — an  │
│   atrium with a planted impluvium in the middle. Twenty-four bays.   │
│ PYRAMID HOUSE                                                        │
│   Seventeen 20-foot units in four stepped tiers, each tier's roof a  │
│   terraced garden with solar. A ziggurat in the woods.               │
│ WALLED COMPOUND                                                      │
│   A perimeter wall of 40-foot units stacked two high, a four-high    │
│   turret at each corner, and a central eight-storey tower with an    │
│   observation deck.                                                  │
│                                                                      │
│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ EXTERIOR                                                             │
│                                                                      │
│ BARE STEEL                                                           │
│   Weathering (corten-style) steel left as delivered. Cheapest shell; │
│   all insulation goes inside, which costs floor width.               │
│ COATED                                                               │
│   Elastomeric / ceramic-loaded coating over the corrugation.         │
│   Reflective, sealed, repaintable. Insulation still inside.          │
│ STONEWORK                                                            │
│   Stone veneer on a ventilated rail over external insulation. The    │
│   cabin look: thermal mass, fireproof, quiet.                        │
│ SPRAY FOAM                                                           │
│   Closed-cell spray foam applied outside the box, then clad.         │
│   Continuous insulation, no thermal bridges, full interior width     │
│   kept.                                                              │
│ BURIED / BERMED                                                      │
│   Earth-sheltered: the box sits in a cut with a sod roof and a       │
│   stone-faced entry. Very stable temperatures. Needs waterproofing,  │
│   drainage, and reinforcement — see notes.                           │
│                                                                      │
│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ GRADE                                                                │
│                                                                      │
│ UTILITARIAN                                                          │
│   Pure function: insulated shell, skid frame with forklift pockets,  │
│   steel steps, small windows, original doors, generator-ready.       │
│   Remote drill operations, survey camps, sites.                      │
│ PREMIUM (YACHT)                                                      │
│   Yacht-grade joinery: teak deck and rail, glazed end wall, brass    │
│   and copper fittings, planters, stone plinth. The civilian cabin.   │
│                                                                      │
│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ MODULES (one per bay)                                                │
│                                                                      │
│ BERTH                                                                │
│   Full berth over drawer storage, lockers above, reading light,      │
│   curtain rail. The one bedroom.                                     │
│ GALLEY                                                               │
│   Counter, sink, induction hob, fridge drawer, overhead lockers.     │
│   Compact as a boat galley.                                          │
│ WET ROOM                                                             │
│   Shower pan, composting toilet, basin, roof vent. Frosted           │
│   partition.                                                         │
│ LOCKER WALL                                                          │
│   Floor-to-ceiling submarine lockers with recessed latches. Where    │
│   everything lives.                                                  │
│ WORKBENCH                                                            │
│   Hardwood bench, vise, pegboard wall, tool shelf, task light. The   │
│   shop.                                                              │
│ MICRO-FARM                                                           │
│   Three-tier hydroponic racks under grow lights. Greens and herbs    │
│   year-round; a roof light over the bay outside.                     │
│ POWER STATION                                                        │
│   Battery rack, inverter, charge controller, breaker panel. Feeds    │
│   the roof solar and the turbine mast.                               │
│ WATER PLANT                                                          │
│   Twin tanks, filter stack, pump, copper runs. Fed from the roof     │
│   gutter and rain barrel.                                            │
│ OPS DESK                                                             │
│   Two screens, radio stack, map board, antenna feed. The ground      │
│   station — drone operations run from here.                          │
│ DRONE BAY                                                            │
│   Charging shelves for small UAS, battery bank, spares wall. Fleet   │
│   ready.                                                             │
│ STOVE                                                                │
│   Small wood stove with a copper flue through the roof, log store,   │
│   warming bench. The steam-punk heart.                               │
│ AIRLOCK                                                              │
│   Inner door and mudroom: bench, boot rack, drying hooks, grated     │
│   floor. For cold sites and dirty work.                              │
│ OPEN FLOOR                                                           │
│   Nothing fitted. Flex space, a table, or room for a module you have │
│   not chosen yet.                                                    │
│                                                                      │
│ ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ NOTES                                                                │
│                                                                      │
│ ! Dimensions are standard ISO: 20' = 6.06 × 2.44 m, 40' = 12.19 ×    │
│   2.44 m, high-cube 2.90 m tall. Bay counts, areas, and the manifest │
│   are computed from those figures.                                   │
│                                                                      │
│ ! Stacking: ISO corner castings and posts carry the loads at sea, so │
│   intact boxes stack corner-on-corner. Every opening cut into a wall │
│   reduces that; the tall layouts here are design examples, and any   │
│   real build gets an engineer.                                       │
│                                                                      │
│ ! Buried / bermed: container walls are not designed for lateral soil │
│   load. An earth-sheltered unit needs a retaining structure,         │
│   membrane waterproofing, and drainage. It is the one option that    │
│   changes the box.                                                   │
│                                                                      │
│ ! This page is a configurator, not a quotation. Costs, delivery, and │
│   site work depend on the ground you are standing on.                │
│                                                                      │
